dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains the floodplain boundaries depicted on Newton's floodplain maps.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property, floodplain management, mitigation, and insurance activities as well as disaster and emergency planning. More advanced user applications may focus on urban policy and planning, development issues, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output).
Supplemental information: Newton is not maintaining this data layer.
